title: gh api --paginate --slurp repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/alerts?state=${state}&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100
description: The repository's code scanning alerts of one state, open or dismissed, as GitHub takes one state a read, which kit asks for in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:code-scanning-alerts, and forge/github:bypasses for the dismissed) and folds in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::github_code_scanning, forge::github_dismissals). gh api --paginate --slurp prints one array of the pages, each an array of alerts. A repository with no analysis answers 404 `no analysis found`, an empty one `no default branch found`, and one without Code Security 403 `Code Security must be enabled for this repository to use code scanning.`, each checked live: the scanner is off. A classic token needs `security_events`, or `public_repo` for a public repository. The types are those of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/code-scanning/alerts in GitHub's REST OpenAPI, https://github.com/github/rest-api-description, as https://docs.github.com/rest/code-scanning/code-scanning#list-code-scanning-alerts-for-a-repository describes them: state is open, dismissed, or fixed; rule.severity none, note, warning, or error; rule.security_severity_level low, medium, high, or critical, or null; dismissed_reason false positive, won't fix, used in tests, or mitigated.
